scope: Photo galleries of the hybrid composition with the baseline gallery contract: the organizer creates a gallery for a tournament, category or match, reviews (approve / reject), sets the cover and order, publishes to the gallery's audience and retires content (hide / restore / revoke a photo, archive / revoke a gallery, handle private reports); the participant reads published galleries of the tournaments it belongs to and reports a photo privately. Every RPC keeps its own capability checks in SQL. Served only with TORNEOS_MEDIA_MODE=on; bytes go through the gateway's upload route (structural verification, gateway-claim write) and reads through its signed-URL route (migration 00000000000012).
